notes.text:
This update for python fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-82049: tarfile extraction filters mishandle archives containing a hard link to a symbolic link, allowing file
  modification and content disclosure (bsc#1280459).

notes.text: In CPython 3.13 and earlier, the tarfile  module's data  and tar extraction filters are vulnerable to crafted archives containing a hard link to a symbolic link. Such archives may cause extraction to modify the permissions or modification time of a file outside the destination directory, or expose the contents of that file within the extracted tree.
